question: cuántos clientes se dieron de alta y no compraron nunca
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.customer_sk) FROM dim_customer d LEFT JOIN fact_payment_attempt f ON d.customer_sk = f.customer_sk WHERE d.signed_up_on IS NOT NULL AND (f.payment_intent_id IS NULL OR f.is_test = true) GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) = 0
